ios.desc:
Transform your iPhone typing experience with FunKey, a custom keyboard extension that brings realistic mechanical keyboard sounds wherever you type. Whether you're sending messages, writing emails, taking notes, or posting on social media, every key press feels more satisfying.

Choose Your Favorite Keyboard Sound. Explore over 25 premium sound profiles inspired by real mechanical keyboards:

• MX Brown, balanced tactile feedback
• Alpha Click, crisp clicky switches
• MX Oreo, deep marbly bottom-out sounds
• Zen Rock, calming low-pitched keystrokes
• Smooth Line, buttery linear switches
• Retro Punk, vintage mechanical feel
• Typewriter, classic typewriter sounds
• Plus Bubble Pop, Blossom, Space Cadet, ASMR, and many more.

Features:

• Works as a custom iOS keyboard extension
• Realistic mechanical keyboard sounds while typing
• Synchronized haptic feedback for every key press
• Adjustable sound volume
• Smooth, responsive typing experience
• 25+ unique sound profiles

**Privacy**

FunKey works entirely on your device. Your typing stays private, and no keyboard data is collected or stored.

Perfect For

• Mechanical keyboard enthusiasts
• ASMR lovers
• Developers and programmers
• Writers and students
• Anyone who wants a more satisfying typing experience

Install FunKey, enable the FunKey keyboard, and enjoy the sound of premium mechanical keyboards anywhere you type on your iPhone.

Privacy policy: https://digitalhole.github.io/funkey.html
Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach us at contact@digitalhole.in
